messages:
nina: Quick sync: RFC follow-up on multi-region active/active handoffs. Ops wants a preflight that proves no secrets will leave the origin region before we allow any automatic prewarm in another region.

omar: Seen the fallout: autoscaler prewarm -> EU tenant served by NA cache for a few minutes. Need deterministic operator boundaries.

kevin: Proposal: introduce a PREPARE -> REPORT -> APPROVE flow. PREPARE returns a report that enumerates all items that would be primed, and flags items needing KMS access. REPORT is immutable and stored. APPROVE issues a scoped prewarm token if compliance conditions are satisfied.

leah: Important: the report must be machine-readable and downloadable. Operators should be able to run the report in dry-run mode (no tokens minted) and share with compliance.

nina: Token semantics: dry_token (metadata-only, no KMS), prewarm_token (allows secret hydration if consent granted). Tokens are single-lease, single-region, single-use, and include claims: tenant_id, lease_id, target_region, consent_level. Validate X-Target-Region header matches token claim.

omar: KMS constraints: we will not decrypt cross-region. Two patterns: (A) customer delegates KMS access to target region, or (B) customer provides rewrapped blobs for target region. Document both.

kevin: Data plane contract: only accept priming requests with X-Dry-Token or X-Prewarm-Token. Any priming without token -> reject 403. This keeps accidental priming from autoscalers impossible.

leah: Observability: emit events prepare.reported, prewarm.requested, prewarm.completed with token ids and operator id. Archive the report as an artifact linked to the event.

infra-bot: infra-bot: feature flag "hand-off-preflight" enabled in staging.

nina: Rollout: start with non-PII tenants behind flag, canary for 24-48h, then opt-in for enterprise. Add SLO: secret-hydration-failure-rate < 0.1%.

omar: Edge-case: token introspection may fail during partition. Dataplane should cache verification for 30s and fail closed for secret-hydration. Metadata priming may proceed if dry_token validated locally.

kevin: Error codes to include in RFC: 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED, 409 REGION_MISMATCH, 423 SECRET_HYDRATION_BLOCKED, 429 TOKEN_RATE_LIMIT.

leah: UI: add "Run preflight (dry)" with CSV export and a checkbox "Require compliance sign-off to approve". Also surface an estimated time + data size.

nina: Action items: Nina will draft RFC extension with API snippets and token claims. Kevin will prototype token minting and introspection. Omar will write KMS patterns doc. Leah will prototype preflight UI and export. Infra-bot schedule canary once prototype exists.

infra-bot: infra-bot: scheduled canary job for preflight at 2026-04-10T03:00Z

nina: Thanks all — this should stop silent residency violations during operator-driven cutovers.
